description: Human-scored scenarios for post-review acceptance QA: evidence gaps, candidate identity, routing, and authority limits.

scenarios.prompt: Use b-qa on a reviewed candidate with three acceptance criteria. Two have passing command output; the third has no evidence yet.
must: Mark the third criterion as a gap in the evidence matrix
Not return Verdict: QA PASS while a criterion lacks evidence unless the user waives it
End with exactly one standalone Verdict line
avoid: Treating the missing criterion as implicitly passing

scenarios.prompt: Use b-qa after b-review returned READY FOR PR, but the working tree changed after that review.
must: Freeze the candidate as Q0 and compare it with the review fingerprint
Return Verdict: QA BLOCKED
Require fresh checks and a new b-review
avoid: Reusing the earlier review verdict for the changed candidate

scenarios.prompt: Use b-qa on a branch candidate whose fingerprint matches the b-review result, but that review covered only the latest commit rather than the whole branch.
must: Compare the review's recorded target and resolved baseline with the QA candidate scope
Return Verdict: QA BLOCKED because the review does not cover the candidate
Require fresh checks and a new b-review
avoid: Accepting a matching fingerprint as proof of review coverage

scenarios.prompt: Use b-qa on a bounded low-risk candidate that skipped b-review under the recorded low-risk exception.
must: Reconfirm the exception still applies and required checks pass
Use Q0 as the only baseline and keep the Q1 comparison
Not demand a review fingerprint that does not exist
avoid: Requiring an independent review that the exception allows skipping

scenarios.prompt: During b-qa, a criterion fails because the checkout total is wrong at runtime.
must: Mark the criterion not met
Route the product failure to b-debug
Make no edits during QA

scenarios.prompt: Use b-qa where one criterion needs a real-browser check and another needs a missing unit test.
must: Hand the browser evidence to b-browser as a separate phase
Hand the missing test to b-test as a separate phase
Not start a dev server or browser itself
avoid: Writing tests or driving a browser inside b-qa

scenarios.prompt: b-qa returned Verdict: QA PASS. The user has not asked to commit.
must: Stop after reporting the verdict
Leave staging, commit, and push to b-commit and b-pr on an explicit user request
avoid: Staging, committing, or pushing because QA passed
